<!-- en -->
v0.1.1-rc.1 is the first prerelease after v0.1.0. It ships fixes and default-behavior adjustments from real-world feedback on v0.1.0: an OpenCode collection fix for an upstream schema change, opt-in client defaults for new installations, router-configuration guarding, and bilingual CLI help. Because prereleases are not selected by default, update explicitly with `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.1`.

### Fixed
- OpenCode: collection no longer fails when `models.json` uses the new registry-shaped provider schema (upstream changed flat `provider → display-name` strings into provider objects); both schemas are parsed, and an unparsable file degrades to an empty mapping with a warning instead of blocking collection

### Changed
- New configurations start with every client disabled (`enabled = false`) and no default router or provider alias — enable the clients you use, then collect. Existing configuration files are not rewritten and are unaffected by this change
- Setting a non-empty `router` on a client outside the Claude family is now rejected at the configuration entry points (`config set` fails up front, including quoted dotted-key forms; the config TUI shows no router field for such clients and save validation rejects one). Clearing with an empty value is always allowed, and existing configurations that already contain such a value are still read without errors
- CLI help is now bilingual (English / 中文) for every user-visible command, including the generated `help`/`completion` commands and their shell subcommands
- The config TUI status message after a successful save now tells you that you can press q to quit or keep editing
- Contributor docs now say commit messages are in English, matching the repository's actual convention

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing v0.1.0 users can update in place with `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.1`; `update` without `--version` keeps resolving only stable releases.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.1-rc.1 是 v0.1.0 之后的第一个预发布版，交付 v0.1.0 实际使用反馈带来的修复与默认行为调整：OpenCode 上游 schema 变化的采集修复、新装配置默认全关、router 配置入口拦截与 CLI 双语帮助。预发布版不会被默认选中，请用 `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.1` 显式升级。

### 修复
- OpenCode：上游把 `models.json` 的扁平 provider→显示名映射改为注册表对象结构后，采集不再失败——两种 schema 均可解析；文件无法解析时降级为空映射并记 WARN 日志，不阻断采集

### 变更
- 新初始化的配置所有客户端默认关闭（`enabled = false`），且不带默认 router 与 provider 别名——按需开启客户端后再采集。已有配置文件不会被重写，不受此变更影响
- 非 Claude 家族客户端设置非空 `router` 会在配置入口被拒绝（`config set` 直接报错，含引号 dotted-key 写法；config TUI 对此类客户端不展示 router 字段，保存校验拒绝非空值）。设为空值清除始终放行；存量配置中已存在的该类值读取不受影响
- CLI 帮助改为双语（English / 中文），覆盖全部用户可见命令，含生成的 `help`/`completion` 命令及其 shell 子命令
- config TUI 保存成功后的状态信息会提示可按 q 退出或继续编辑
- 贡献指南的提交信息语言表述改为英文，与仓库实际惯例一致

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。v0.1.0 用户可 `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.1` 原地升级；不带 `--version` 的 `update` 仍只解析稳定版。
